text: dsh-token-rush 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话悬浮仪表，在会话页叠加显示当前会话的输入、输出和缓存 Token 数，并按模型及当前高峰时段估算费用。它还定时查询并展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，根据配置的工作时段与时区提示高峰状态，支持拖动和记忆窗口位置。适合希望在使用 DSH 时随时查看会话用量、费用估算和 DeepSeek 余额的用户。余额功能可复用 DSH 模型设置中的 DeepSeek API Key；没有配置 Key 时仍可查看用量与估算费用。

dsh-token-rush is a DSH Web session HUD showing token counts and estimated spend by model and peak period. It displays DeepSeek balance and peak status, refreshes data, and lets users move the window. Balance lookup uses the DeepSeek API key configured in DSH; usage estimates work without it.
想在 DSH 会话里直接看到这轮用了多少输入和输出 Token。
有没有办法边聊天边看当前会话大概花了多少钱？
Show my current session's token usage and estimated spend inside the DSH web page.
dsh-token-rush 的功能「会话用量与费用」：在会话悬浮窗显示输入、输出 Token 总量，并按模型和当前时段单价估算费用。切换会话或用量快照更新时自动刷新显示。
dsh-token-rush 的功能「余额与高峰提示」：通过宿主端查询 DeepSeek 余额，并在会话窗显示余额和当前高峰状态；浏览器端定时刷新相关信息。余额查询使用已配置的 DeepSeek 密钥。
dsh-token-rush 使用 DSH 配置的 DeepSeek API Key 请求 api.deepseek.com 的余额接口；余额查询需要此密钥，用量与费用估算不依赖余额查询。

dsh-token-rush README · 为什么需要它：作为一个贫穷的 API 使用者，你是否也有像我一样的 token 焦虑？

每次让 AI 干活，都忍不住切到后台看一眼这轮烧了多少 token；等账单出来才发现，明明聊得很爽，钱包却已经瘦了两斤。更惨的是：白天 9 点到 12 点、下午 14 点到 18 点（北京时间），DeepSeek 的高峰时段单价是平时的 **2 倍**——你以为是闲聊，实际上是双倍扣费。

**dsh-token-rush** 把答案钉在会话页左上角：一个永远跟着你走的小窗口，实时显示当前会话累计消耗的 token、按官方单价估算的金额、以及账户余额；每到高峰时段，窗口整体变橙红色，等于在你耳边喊了一句：

> "现在用 AI，是两倍价格，悠着点。"

*上图：会话进行中的实际效果 —— 左上角悬浮窗，实时显示总 Token（进/出）、估算消耗与账户余额；当前为空闲时段，窗口颜色跟随 DSH 主题；高峰时段整体变橙红色。*

dsh-token-rush README · 数据口径：| 项目 | 来源 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 总 Token | DSH 会话 `tokenUsage` 投影（`uncachedInputTokens` / `cacheReadTokens` / `cacheWriteTokens` / `outputTokens`） | host 按会话日志维护的 provider 上报总值，实时推送 |
| 消耗金额（估算 ≈） | Token × 官方单价表 | 价格按模型匹配（`deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` / …，未知模型回退 Flash 价），模型取最近一次**实际发起请求**的模型（`modelSelection.lastUsed`，未跑过请求时取待用选择），高峰价 = 空闲价 ×2；单价表快照在浏览器半区 `lib/client.js`（算账的一方为准，host 只补充它还不认识的模型） |
| 账户余额 | DeepSeek `/user/balance` | host 缓存 60s，浏览器每分钟拉取一次 |
| 高峰判定 | host 提供窗口 / 时区 / 节假日配置，浏览器按同一规则判定 | 每次 DSH 启动另记一条 host 判定日志；默认北京时间工作日窗口，周末与法定节假日全天空闲；浏览器半区随 client-hmr 热更新，因此判定不受 host 半区版本影响 |
| 只读路由访问控制 | Host / Origin 校验 | 同源网页请求与桌面端（`dsh-app://app` 转发，会剥掉 Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site）均可读取；跨站请求、非本机 loopback Host（DNS rebinding）一律 403 |

dsh-token-rush README · 已知限制：- 消耗金额为**估算值**：token 总量来自 provider 上报；价格取最近一次实际请求所用的模型，且整段会话按**当前**时段单价折算 —— 若一次会话跨越 09:00 / 12:00 / 14:00 / 18:00 的时段边界，跨界的部分仍按当前时段计价。实际扣费以 DeepSeek 账单为准。
- 内置法定节假日清单仅覆盖 **2026 年**（依据国办发明电〔2025〕7 号）；其他年份请用 `DSH_HUD_PEAK_HOLIDAYS` 指定，否则节假日的工作日会被算成高峰。
- 余额查询仅覆盖 DeepSeek 官方 API（含自定义 `baseURL` 端点）；使用其他 LLM 供应商时余额行显示「余额不可用」。
- 高峰时段判定默认使用北京时间（与官方计费口径一致），可按需用 `DSH_HUD_PEAK_TZ` 修改。

dsh-token-rush README · Why you need it：As a broke API user, don't you have the same token anxiety I do?

Every time you ask the AI to do something, you can't help switching to the backend to check how many tokens this round burned. By the time the bill arrives, you realize the conversation felt great — but your wallet lost two pounds. Worse: between 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (Beijing time), DeepSeek charges **2×** the normal rate during its peak hours. You thought it was a casual chat; it was actually double-priced.

dsh-token-rush README · Why you need it：**dsh-token-rush** puts the answer right on the session page's top-left corner: a small window that follows you, showing the current session's cumulative token consumption, the estimated spend at official prices, and your account balance. Whenever peak hours hit, the whole window turns orange-red — as if it is whispering in your ear:

> "Using AI right now costs double. Take it easy."

dsh-token-rush README · Data sources：| Item | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Total tokens | DSH session `tokenUsage` projection (`uncachedInputTokens` / `cacheReadTokens` / `cacheWriteTokens` / `outputTokens`) | Provider-reported session totals maintained by the host; live push |
| Spend (est. ≈) | Tokens × official price table | Per-model price matching (`deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` / …, unknown models fall back to Flash); the model is the one that actually served a request (`modelSelection.lastUsed`, falling back to the pending selection), peak = 2× valley; the table is snapshotted in the browser half (`lib/client.js`) — the half doing the math owns it, and a host table only adds models this bundle does not know |
| Account balance | DeepSeek `/user/balance` | 60s host cache; the browser polls once a minute |
| Rush-hour state | The host supplies windows / timezone / holiday configuration; the browser applies the same rule | One host verdict is also logged per DSH launch; Beijing-time weekday windows by default, weekends and statutory holidays never peak; the browser half hot-reloads, so the verdict never depends on the host half's vintage |

dsh-token-rush README · Known limitations：- Spend is an **estimate**: token totals come from provider reports; the price uses the model that actually served a request, and the whole session is converted at the **current** price bucket — a session spanning 09:00 / 12:00 / 14:00 / 18:00 keeps pricing its earlier tokens at today's bucket. Actual billing is what DeepSeek says it is.
- The built-in statutory-holiday list covers **2026 only** (per 国办发明电〔2025〕7 号); set `DSH_HUD_PEAK_HOLIDAYS` for other years, or holiday weekdays are counted as peak.
- Balance only covers the official DeepSeek API (including custom `baseURL` endpoints); with other LLM providers the balance row shows "Unavailable".
- Rush-hour detection defaults to Beijing time (matching the official billing rules); override with `DSH_HUD_PEAK_TZ` if needed.

dsh-token-rush README · Development：> The browser half (`lib/client.js`) is watched by DSH's client-hmr poll: saving the file reloads the plugin in a running page without a restart.
> The host half (`lib/index.js`) is not hot-reloaded: DSH applies plugin changes "at the next start" (the Plugin Manager page says the same), so restart `dsh web` / the desktop app after changing it.
> Spend and the rush-hour verdict therefore always come from the browser half; the host only supplies configuration and the balance proxy, so a version gap can never distort the numbers on screen.
